goal: Travel from Pewter City through Mt Moon and reach Cerulean City

subgoals.goal_text: Leave Pewter City to the east to enter Route 3
Travel across Route 3 to reach the entrance of Mt Moon
Navigate through the first floor of Mt Moon and find the stairs down
Navigate through the basement 1 floor of Mt Moon and find the stairs down
Navigate through the bottom floor of Mt Moon to reach the exit
Heal your party at the Pokemon Center inside Mt Moon
Leave the Mt Moon Pokemon Center and exit the cave to Route 4
Travel across Route 4 to reach Cerulean City
